annotations.title: Answer a defence prompt by hand

description: Answer the open defence prompt by hand (the SDK answers it with the plain default when you do not): { success, refused, forkSave, choice: "inner"|"outer" } as the prompt allows.

choice.description: which of the two the prompt offers to keep: inner or outer

forkSave.description: true to use the fork’s save, where the open prompt offers one

refused.description: true to refuse the defence, where the open prompt allows it

success.description: true to answer that the defence succeeds, where the open prompt allows it

name: defend
title: Answer a defence prompt by hand
